units.rawText: I always record my patient's appearance with a mask... With their approval, of course.

units.rawText: Now I have the casted masks of thousands of living people, all lined up on my shelves. Each one of them represents a moment, a small part of our world, forever frozen in time.

units.rawText: These moments may seem insignificant to someone else, but in a way, they prove their owners' existence.
